group_position: last shot of grp028 — the White Rabbit reaches his map end (curtain, pulled up a few feet short of the giant girl). Alice holds the curtain, out of frame.

characters.label: White Rabbit
characters.start_pos: pulled up short of her in the shallow water at the low curtain, sitting back on his haunches
characters.space_fragment_en: sitting back on his haunches in the shallow water short of the low curtain, held screen-left, facing screen-left away up the hall
characters.facing: screen-left, up the hall and away from Alice — he has not registered her and the frame makes that literal

beats.action: pulls up and sits back on his haunches
beats.sync: the pause that frees his forepaws

beats.action: the gloves and the fan come out of his mouth into his forepaws
beats.sync: the only point in S08 where he handles them

beats.action: his whole body flinches at his own word

characters.staging_lock: The mouth-carry is released only because he has stopped and sat back; the moment he moves again he is on four legs with the props in his mouth.

performance.objective: talk himself into moving faster before his own imagination gets any worse
performance.emotional_arc: from fussy grievance to genuine fear of a person who is not in the room
performance.end_state: sitting back with the gloves and fan clutched to his chest, ears flat, muzzle working, facing screen-left

offscreen_presence.where: sitting at the low curtain, a few feet behind him and far above him
offscreen_presence.note: In the space, out of frame.

presence_check.note: Performance is muzzle, ears and the set of his back only.
